returns._0: The address of the Aerodrome locker factory contract.

collectFees(address).details: This function can only be called by the fee account.

params.pool: The address of the pool associated with the liquidity position.

returns.amount0: The amount of token0 fees collected.
returns.amount1: The amount of token1 fees collected.

lock(uint256,address).details: This function can only be called by the liquidity migrator.

params.pool: The address of the pool associated with the liquidity position.
params.tokenId: The ID of the liquidity position NFT to lock.

params.pool: The address of the associated pool.

returns.tokenId: The ID of the locked liquidity position NFT.

returns._0: Returns the total number of locked positions in the locker.

params.pool: The address of the pool associated with the liquidity position.

params.index: The index of the pool in the list.

setLiquidityMigrator(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._liquidityMigrator: The address of the new liquidity migrator contract.

collectFees(address).notice: Collects the fees generated by a locked liquidity position.

lock(uint256,address).notice: Locks a liquidity position NFT in the locker.

lockedPosition(address).notice: Returns the token ID of the locked liquidity position for a specific pool.

migrateLiquidity(address).notice: Migrates a locked liquidity position to a Aerodrome locker.

poolAt(uint256).notice: Returns the pool address at a specific index in the list of locked pools.

setLiquidityMigrator(address).notice: Sets the address of the liquidity migrator contract.
